stem: Find the line passing through the point $(-3, -8)$ with gradient $1$. Drag the two points so the line is that line. (Use a point you can place on the board.)

hints.text: The line must pass through the given point. Substitute it into y − y₁ = m(x − x₁) to find where the line meets the y-axis.
A gradient of 1 means the line rises as you move right.
Start from y − y₁ = m(x − x₁) with the given gradient and point.

notes: The given point lies off the default board, but the line y=x-5 has lattice points on it (e.g. (0,-5), (5,0)).
